_source: Sampled by `bun packages/ui-mac/test-fixtures/engine-adapter-sampler/sample.ts` (alpha-code#1668 L6) at 5f2880fd63: a real OpenCode 2 engine from this repo's packages/cli `serve`, isolated HOME/XDG, one git project, and the scripted OpenAI-compatible mock model next to the sampler. Approval action parity: POST /api/session/:id/permission, under a sampler-only agent whose rules ask for every request (added to the global config after every other scenario; a session-row ask no longer decides anything since I-13 L2), creates shell and subagent capability requests without policy metadata, plus a shell request with the frozen I7a metadata.policy keys supplied to the public API; each request here is the raw GET /api/session/:id/permission/:requestID response. This samples the engine's public permission API, as permission-reply does, not a model/tool invocation; no ext runs here. The comparison's expected v1 actions come from the Code Puppy command/delegation cards, never from the translator's response.
